_comment: Git-mode compat deltas — used when the candidate runs with NO DB migration (default-source=git), so every v1/v2/v3 response is served by the Git resolver, the same code path as the 2.0.87 baseline. This file encodes the deploy-without-migration invariant, which now reads: a no-op EXCEPT for the components the old equality contract was silently dropping. It stayed empty for as long as every change was DB-path-only; TD-022/TD-023 repaired JiraComponentVersionRange.equals and the vacuous Distribution.equals in the SHARED resolver-api, so the Git resolver stops dropping those components too — which is the point of the fix, not a regression of it. Nothing else may be added lightly: any other active diff here is a real regression of the invariant and must be FIXED, not suppressed. The db-mode deltas live in known-deltas-db.json. Selected via -Pcompat.known-deltas=known-deltas-git.json. See docs/registry/api-compat-deltas.md.

deltas.reason: TD-022 + TD-023 (2026-09): JiraComponentVersionRange.equals omitted componentName and Distribution.equals compared nothing, so components sharing a Jira project, a version range and a VCS root collapsed into one element of the returned Set — silently, on BOTH resolvers. Repairing those contracts lives in the shared component-resolver-api, so the Git path stops dropping them as well and the candidate returns MORE elements than the baseline. This is the fix working, not the invariant breaking. It does NOT accept an arbitrary superset: the 'TD-022 RECOVERY CONFIRMED' marker is emitted by Adr021RangeRecovery only when nothing is lost, every addition's componentName is absent from the baseline ranges yet present in the baseline's /components inventory, a baseline twin exists under the real equality contract, and — in git-mode — the addition carries NO display name, so the repaired contract is the only thing that can explain it. A name appearing in git-mode is still refused, because ADR-021 applies to the DB resolver alone. Affected component keys are withheld from this public repo; they are named in the build's summary.md.
deltas.regressionTest: Adr021RangeRecoveryTest (contract-caused recovery confirmed in both modes; name-caused recovery still refused in git-mode; plus the loss / no-twin / duplicate / unknown-component refusals)
